name: TableView
title: Templates/Platform/Lists/TableView
summary: The canonical first-level list page: a medium page heading with the resource name and its one-line description, the Documentation and Create actions on the medium step (on a phone they stack below the copy, each at full width), then the controls row, the applied-filter chips and the resource table, laid out with the console page column and section rhythm. The controls are wired to the table: the filters narrow the rows and send the table back to its first page, the search drives the table’s global filter, the columns panel drives its column visibility, Refresh puts it in its loading state and Download CSV exports it. Any resource index takes this shape with its own columns. When the account has no resources left, the page keeps its heading and the controls row, and the table, without its header and footer, gives way to a flush `Card` holding only a medium `EmptyState` (the resource glyph, then a small secondary Create and a small outlined Docs on one row), so the list survives its last row being deleted. Laid out with the theme’s `layout-boundary`, `layout-column` and `layout-section-start` utilities carrying the inset, the measure and the vertical rhythm. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: Every resource deleted on an account that is not new: the page keeps its heading and controls, and the table, without its header or footer, gives way to a flush Card that holds only a medium EmptyState led by the resource glyph, with a small secondary Create Resource and a small outlined Docs button.
